mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods of sustained FEDFUNDS decline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth (YoY) falls below 1.0% and industrial production declines by more than 0.5% over the past three months, it signals a severe economic slowdown that typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both GDPC1 YoY < 1.0% and INDPRO 3m change < -0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a 0.25 percentage point increase in the federal funds rate within one month signals aggressive policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 1 month during a monetary tightening cycle (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production exceeding 1.0% signals a significant contraction in manufacturing output, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in instances where INDPRO falls > 1.0% in 3 months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in housing starts exceeding 2.0% signals weakening residential demand, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST falls > 2.0% in 3 months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), a further 0.5 percentage point increase in annual inflation within one month signals persistent inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL YoY rises > 0.5pp in 1 month during a high-inflation regime (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE > 0.1pp increase in 3 months) and slowing employment growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.5% in 3 months) signals a weakening labor market, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in 3 months AND PAYEMS growth < 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in 3 months and PAYEMS growth < 0.5% in 3 months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
